Crack the Sky

Repo layout

← overview

Top level

Four Python packages plus tests and ops scripts. Jobs are python -m ingest.jobs.<name> (or python -m pricing.term_structure / python -m signals.spot) from the venv (pip install -e . so imports do not depend on cwd). No console-script entry points.

PathWhat it is
ingest/ Capture. REST, delayed websocket, S3 flat files, schemas, cron jobs, entitlements probe.
marketdata/ Typed reads of clean parquet. OPRA parse, Contract/Quote/Forward, catalog as-of, fail-loud validate.
pricing/ Calculators plus the one fitted object. BSM catalog, IV invert, Engine (European analytic / American CRR), from_market, drift_check, calendar (session counts from the attested + upcoming calendars), daycount (vol-time convention as a passed object; day-bar default is the hybrid — sessions inside the calendar horizon, ACT/365 past it — stamped per row as bus/252 or act/365; money time is always ACT/365), term_structure (the ATM curve), surface (raw-SVI smile per expiry over the own-IV chain, with arb guards and term interpolation).
signals/ Derived market series that sit on ingest + pricing reductions. signals.spot writes spy_spot — SPY cash level from the day-bar close, else the shortest-DTE parity proxy. signals.har_rv turns that series into rv_forecast — the walk-forward HAR-RV baseline with a lognormal uncertainty band.
tests/ Offline pytest: ingest, tests/marketdata/, tests/pricing/, plus Healthchecks/schedule drift tests.
docs/ This handbook: index.html plus one page per section, red-day.html / latent.html, and box-operations.html for off-repo machine state. Known holes that are in the tree live in IMPROVEMENTS.md.
deploy/ schedule.json (source of schedule), crontab (kept installed through the timer cutover), the Ansible playbook + unit templates that generate the systemd timers, and an optional systemd unit for the websocket job.
scripts/ bootstrap, backfill, backfill_underlying, repair, prune_raw, Healthchecks setup, build_term_structure.py (rebuilds the ATM curve over the archive), build_surface.py (same for the SVI surface), build_spy_spot.py (SPY spot series + overlap calibration), build_rv_forecast.py (walk-forward HAR-RV over the spot archive). Not a package.

Not in the repo

There is no surfaces/, no rates package, no ClickHouse client. The schemas module mentions ClickHouse in a docstring; no DDL ships.
